Renames show no previous_filename: list the parent tree to find the old path (WorkspaceProfile.js was agent/lib/project.js before 184cb712). Verify reconstructions with git blob sha1('blob <len>\0'+content). The P0 workflow on fix branches has a 'full' job (copy from fix/p0-1 96e712b) that reports every npm-test file's pass/fail + failing output in the p0-report comment, use it as the log source for structured-ai CI failures. Settings: new runtime values must be SettingsSchema definitions read via require('../config').get(); no process.env reads or UPPER_CASE literal constants in agent/ code. ArgParser.js (93ad8b6b) and Cli.js (93ad8b6b+9411b5be+184cb712+PR#23) reconstruct exactly. get_commit file lists are paged at 30 per page by default: pass page=N, perPage=100 until fewer than 100 come back. A merge commit patch is against its first parent: when list_commits has both the merge and a branch commit touching a file, apply only the merge (McpManager.js). Files that cannot be reconstructed (policy.json, runtime.test.js) can be dumped by the report job: the P0 workflow on fix/p0-2 checks out the repo in the report job and posts a "source excerpts" section; edit its file list as needed.
